paragraphs: Rav Mesharshiya bar Chilkai: [Ketubot 100b](https://www.sefaria.org/Ketubot.100b.17). Sama bar Chilkai: [Chullin 38a](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.38a.14).[^1]

notes.text: [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2564&lang=en) records Mesharshiya bar Chilkai in Rav Kahana’s time, as in Ketubot. Chullin names Sama bar Chilkai in a different discussion.
